title: SCOPE: A Dataset of Stereotyped Prompts for Counterfactual Fairness Assessment of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual fairness testing by issuing paired prompt queries that are semantically identical but differ only in the referenced race or color group, then comparing the model outputs for differences in length, focus, or structure.
